# Pull Request

## Description
Describe what this change does and why it’s needed.

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation update

## How Has This Been Tested?
Explain test strategy and include screenshots or recordings if UI changes.

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project style and patterns
- [ ] I have run `npm run lint`
- [ ] I have added tests or explanations where necessary
- [ ] I have updated documentation where appropriate
- [ ] I have linked related issues
